reuse.why: Builds on the existing linkBankSyncAccount helper for the duplicate, closed and takeover rules and for the new Fintegra link, and extracts unlinkAccount's clearing for reuse, but downloadFintegraTransactions copies the Akahu download function.

duplication.why: The link rules exist once and every provider goes through them; the only duplicated block is the Fintegra download, a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions.

placement.why: Link rules live in the shared link helper in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, config and types in their usual modules.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps, apart from an unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: Moving bank creation into linkBankSyncAccount lets all checks run before any write in one place; the copied download function is the remaining maintenance cost.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount's bank parameter is split into institution+bankId so it can validate before creating the bank, and it gains replaceExistingLink; no provider-specific branches are added and all six link functions call it
